You're going to take a lot of crap you'll never use. Think, seriously, if you have used something or have had a need to use something in the last 2 or 3 months. If not, then don't take it. You probably won't miss it. A lot of this stuff for me was books/games/whatever that I ended up just having for decoration and didn't touch because I kept playing stuff that was new or had never read.

The things I know that I -forgot- to take my first time are: - A good power strip - 2-ply toilet paper (trust me) - Trash bags - Extra towels - Plastic forks/spoons/knives or cheap real ones - Medicine (Consider: Headache, Fever, Cold, Flu the most) - A clothes bin/bag - If you plan to cook: Consider cooking utensils/spices/condiments - SHOWER SANDALS - Batteries - A fan (dorm a/c can be very questionable) - A good blanket (see above) - Paper towels - If you have a car, be sure you have jumper cables, tools to remove/replace your tire, and maybe a basic toolset and learn how to use all of them. It's really very handy and if you know a little bit you can save a lot of money. This might seem obvious to most people but I have seen a lot of new college students get a flat or something and end up spending a lot for a truck/shop call.

Most of these aren't a problem if your dorm/uni is near a decent store. Also, do yourself a favor and go ahead and buy a big pack of pens or pencils or whatever and put them in your backpack somewhere. Then go buy another pack that you actually plan to use. You don't want to have to be that guy that has to ask for a pen/pencil from your neighbor. I ended up buying most of this stuff from the store within the first week.

Don't buy your books from the school bookstore. See if you can get them from Amazon or any other locations, it's way cheaper and reselling to the bookstore is a complete ripoff. It's meant explicitly to exploit freshmen who don't know any better yet.

I can't really think of any more must haves. I was trying to list ones that don't seem to stand out and be obvious that you would need until you think about it. Let me know if you have more questions!

• good power strip
  • 2-ply tp
  • trash bags
  • extra towels
  • plastic eating utensils
  • basic over-the-counter meds
  • clothes bin/bag
  • cooking untensils (not allowed in my dorm)

  • batteries
  • fan
  • good blanket
  • paper towels
  • jumper cables
  • basic toolset
  • tire tools
  • extra pens/pencils
  • textbooks but never from the school bookstore
